description: Scan what your AI agent reads before it acts: a stdio MCP wrapper for the hosted Agent-Shield API. One tool, shield_scan, checks untrusted content (tool outputs, fetched pages, files) for prompt-injection patterns, leaked secrets, exposed PII and SSRF-risk URLs, and returns a verdict plus a signed receipt.
name: io.github.startekenterprises-ai/agent-shield

environmentVariables.description: Free Agent-Shield API key (1,000 scans/day, no email). Get one: POST https://agent-shield.startekenterprises.com/v1/signup with JSON {"label":"my-agent"}.
environmentVariables.name: AGENT_SHIELD_API_KEY

title: Agent-Shield
